purpose: Empirically qualify the documented Quantum ESPRESSO --ipi socket communication path for exact QE 7.6 and i-PI 3.3.0 releases before any H/Ru quantum-nuclear production work.

interface_under_test.source: Quantum ESPRESSO PWscf user guide socket interface with i-PI
interface_under_test.note: The alternative i-PI-documented calculation='driver'/srvaddress syntax is not silently substituted if this test fails; it requires a separately versioned follow-up test.

pass_requirements: QE source checkout resolves to the frozen qe-7.6 commit
i-PI source checkout resolves to the frozen v3.3.0 commit
downloaded i-PI wheel matches the frozen SHA-256
QE pw.x builds successfully from the frozen source commit
i-PI 3.3.0 installs from the frozen wheel
i-PI server starts from the frozen example-derived input
QE client connects using the frozen --ipi invocation
i-PI produces at least one trajectory frame and property record beyond initialization
QE client log shows socket-driven execution without interface error
server/client processes terminate after the bounded smoke test or are cleanly stopped after producing the required exchange
logs and software/runtime identities are preserved
